mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POST_COMMENT(COMMENT_ID, POST_ID, MEMBER_ID, CONTENT, PARENT_COMMENT_ID, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_POST_COMMENT.NEXTVAL, #{postId}, #{memberId}, #{content}, #{parentCommentId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, 0, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM POST_COMMENT WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} AND PARENT_COMMENT_ID IS NULL AND STATUS = 0

SELECT C.COMMENT_ID AS commentId, C.POST_ID AS postId, C.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, M.NAME AS memberName, C.CONTENT AS content, C.STATUS AS status, TO_CHAR(C.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt, NVL(A.answerCount, 0) AS answerCount FROM POST_COMMENT C JOIN MEMBER M ON C.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT PARENT_COMMENT_ID, COUNT(*) AS answerCount FROM POST_COMMENT WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} AND PARENT_COMMENT_ID IS NOT NULL AND STATUS = 0 GROUP BY PARENT_COMMENT_ID ) A ON C.COMMENT_ID = A.PARENT_COMMENT_ID WHERE C.POST_ID = #{postId} AND C.PARENT_COMMENT_ID IS NULL AND C.STATUS = 0 ORDER BY C.COMMENT_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT C.COMMENT_ID AS commentId, C.POST_ID AS postId, C.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, M.NAME AS memberName, C.CONTENT AS content, C.PARENT_COMMENT_ID AS parentCommentId, C.STATUS AS status, TO_CHAR(C.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt FROM POST_COMMENT C JOIN MEMBER M ON C.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID WHERE C.POST_ID = #{postId} AND C.PARENT_COMMENT_ID = #{parentCommentId} AND C.STATUS = 0 ORDER BY C.COMMENT_ID DESC
SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM POST_COMMENT WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} AND PARENT_COMMENT_ID = #{parentCommentId} AND STATUS = 0
SELECT COMMENT_ID AS commentId, POST_ID AS postId, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, PARENT_COMMENT_ID AS parentCommentId, STATUS AS status FROM POST_COMMENT WHERE COMMENT_ID = #{commentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE POST_COMMENT SET CONTENT = #{content}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE COMMENT_ID = #{commentId} AND POST_ID = #{postId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 0
UPDATE POST_COMMENT SET STATUS = 2, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE COMMENT_ID = #{commentId} AND POST_ID = #{postId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 0
UPDATE POST_COMMENT SET STATUS = 1, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE COMMENT_ID = #{commentId} AND POST_ID = #{postId} AND STATUS = 0
